findings.evidence: governance/runtime/ACTIVE_TASK.json lines 42-44 only require `python3 scripts/check_db_schema.py` and `python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_r15_notification_support_postgres.py`. The pytest reads SQL text and asserts markers (`tests/test_r15_notification_support_postgres.py` lines 27-46 and 62-82) and only checks catalog paths are nonempty (lines 84-113). Meanwhile the catalog marks all six R15 rows as `AUTOMATED` (`catalogs/test_cases.csv` lines 144-149), but the adapter files are plain text pointers, e.g. `tests/r15/README.md` lines 3-8. The executable SQL `database/tests/r15_notification_support_invariants.sql` is never executed by the acceptance pytest, so the claimed DB/API/INTEGRATION automation is not real.
findings.issue: 候选通过方式弱化/冒用测试自动化：R15 数据库不变量只做文本标记检查和空文件存在性检查，未真实运行 PostgreSQL invariant SQL，却把六个 R15 合同测试从 READY_TO_AUTOMATE 改为 AUTOMATED。对 database/production 风险任务，这不能证明迁移、触发器和拒绝路径真实通过。
